info.title: Decision Kernel API
info.description: Additive evolution within /v1. Unknown request fields are rejected. Credentials are separate. Feedback identity enforcement is a deliberate security tightening; migrate reviewer clients before rollout.

servers.description: Local development; use HTTPS in deployments

post.description: Fast profile only. Max body 64 KiB; duplicate JSON keys and unknown fields rejected. A receipt is immutable; application executes actions only after checking disposition.
